name: Velora Nitely and the Brutal Legguards

meta.wiki: Velora Nitely and the Brutal Legguards

summary: Thun'grim Firegaze sends Horde warriors across the Great Sea for Velora Nitely's Brutal Legguards. In the Undercity, the Forsaken smith draws on the craft she kept from her mortal life to forge the armor. Her work helps assemble a durable suit for the Horde's warriors.

sections.title: A Journey Across the Sea
sections.body: Thun'grim Firegaze sends you east across the Great Sea to find a smith for the Brutal Legguards. You've proved your mettle to the veteran smith at his vigil in the Barrens, and now he points you toward the fabled Brutal Armor. Thun'grim cannot make the whole suit alone, so he relies on skilled allies across the Horde. The greaves call for an artisan whose work was revered before northern humanity fell, in the Forsaken's underground kingdom.

sections.title: The Artistry of Velora Nitely
sections.body: Velora Nitely works in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, where her old craft still serves the Horde. Before the Scourging of the north ended her mortal life, she was one of the Kingdom of Lordaeron's foremost armorsmiths. Her homeland was corrupted, and she became one of the Forsaken, but death did not take her mastery of metal. She now turns her human skill toward the Horde's warriors, with a dry, macabre wit about being undead.

faq.answer: Velora Nitely was once celebrated as one of the finest armorsmiths in the kingdom of Lordaeron. After the Third War, she rose again as one of the Forsaken and made her home in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, where she still practices her craft for the Horde.

faq.q: Why does Thun'grim send me to Undercity?
faq.answer: Thun'grim Firegaze sends you to the Undercity because the full Brutal Armor set calls for skilled artisans across the Horde. He knows Velora's reputation for armor and dispatches you to Lordaeron to commission the legguards from her.

faq.q: Where can I find Velora Nitely in the Undercity?
faq.answer: Velora Nitely works in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity, at the forges among smiths and other master crafters serving Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: What comes after speaking to Velora Nitely?
faq.answer: Velora asks you to gather shinbones from Dragonmaw orcs in the Wetlands for your Brutal Legguards.

faq.q: Does Velora have any dialogue about being undead?
faq.answer: Yes. Velora dryly jokes about whether she is making the armor for you or the other way around. She says she lost her sense of humor around the time she lost her sense of smell and stopped breathing.

faq.q: Is Brutal Armor only for warriors?
aliases: can other classes get brutal armor
faq.answer: Yes. The Brutal Armor trials, including seeking Velora Nitely for the legguards, are for Horde warriors advancing through the seasoned ranks.

angles.text: As a warrior, you reach a milestone in the Horde's armor trials around level thirty, traveling beyond Kalimdor for specialized class armor.
As Forsaken, you can see Velora Nitely carrying on the refined skills and artistic legacy of fallen Lordaeron.
As Horde, you join a line of work that brings orcs, trolls, and tauren from Kalimdor together with Forsaken craftsmen in the Eastern Kingdoms.
